liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **It Hurts Me Too** (1 review): Pigpen is noted as being in fine form on this track [6]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Billy's drumming on this song is described as fantastic by the listener [12]
- **Cream Puff War** (1 review): The source claims this was the first time the band played the song live [15]

## The recordings

- **gd66-05-19.sbd.lestatkat.6516.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 67 min; rated 4.64/5 by 53 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording quality is considered great for a tape made over thirty years ago; The sound is described as excellent for a concert that was thirty-eight years old; The bass drum sound is specifically highlighted as a positive aspect of the recording [6][8][10]
- **gd1966-05-19.sbd.miller.106828.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 67 min; rated 3.67/5 by 9 [3]
- **gd1966-05-19.sbd.miller.106683.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 67 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd66-05-19.sbd.sonicsolutions.82844.flac**: soundboard; 17 songs; 66 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd66-05-19.sbd.lestatkat.6516.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The recording first appeared on a few GDH hours, credited to David Gans; The audio lineage is listed as dat to fm broadcast to cdr to shn [1][7]
- **gd1966-05-19.sbd.miller.106828.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [3]. Also: The file is an upgrade to shnid 106683 with minor level adjustments added [3]
- **gd1966-05-19.sbd.miller.106683.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat -> Sonic Solutions -> CD [2]
- **gd66-05-19.sbd.sonicsolutions.82844.flac**: source: SBD > Reel > DAT > Sonic Solutions > DAT > DAT > CDR [4]
